TagLib Android 1.0.6
https://github.com/Kyant0/taglib/tree/957fd7c2794457a14c1484fa3e3b58382aca4202

taglib-android-1.0.6.tar.gz contains the unchanged taglib.cpp, utils.h,
fileref_ext.cpp and fileref_ext.h from src/main/cpp, plus the upstream LICENSE.
The Kotlin API and keep rules are extracted from the verified Maven AAR.
taglib-android-unicode.patch converts JNI strings through UTF-16 in both
directions and releases temporary JNI resources. taglib-android-format.patch
detects containers by content before falling back to the file extension.
CMake applies both patches to a fresh build-directory copy when configuring.

TagLib 2.3
https://github.com/taglib/taglib/releases/download/v2.3/taglib-2.3.tar.gz

This official release archive includes utfcpp. The Android wrapper's recorded
core commit 1cbd910c3da4818e835ee6d6e467157366d5f1bb is unavailable from the
public TagLib repository; Media Lab pins the 2.3 release for reproducible builds.
Archive SHA-256 values are checked in app/src/main/cpp/CMakeLists.txt.
